entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Elisabeth ("Lisanne") Anne Marie Lejeune is a former Dutch field hockey defender. She won a bronze medal at the 1988 Summer Olympics, world titles in 
1986 and 1990, European title in 1987, and the Hockey Champions Trophy in 1987.
